title: ಶಿಶುನಾಳ ಶರೀಫರ ತತ್ವಪದಗಳು
author: ಶಿಶುನಾಳ ಶರೀಫ
description: ಹಾವೇರಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಶಿಶುನಾಳದ ಸಂತ ಶರೀಫರ ೨೩ ಆಯ್ದ ತತ್ವಪದಗಳು — ಬೆಡಗು, ದೇಹ-ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ರೂಪಕ, ನೀತಿ, ಹಿಂದೂ-ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ ಸಾಮರಸ್ಯ. ಅಂಕಿತ: ಶಿಶುನಾಳಧೀಶ; ಗುರುಸ್ಮರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೋವಿಂದ.

provenance.licenseNote: Shishunala Sharif (ಶಿಶುನಾಳ ಶರೀಫ) died 1889 CE; text is public domain worldwide. Taken from the Kannada Wikisource edition: the author index page above links one page per tatvapada (plus two padas printed on the index itself, and ಲೋಕದ ಕಾಳಜಿ as a separate page); the exact pages used are listed in sources.txt beside this file. Only the verse text was taken (modern remarks, navigation, variant-reading notes and refrain-repeat cues were dropped).
